name: January 27, 2026 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  JANUARY 27, 2026
  MALIBU CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Chair Jones called the meeting to order at 9:37 am.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Vice Chair Peter Jones; Commissioners Maureen Haldeman, Pamela Conley
  Ulich, and Dennis Smith

  ABSENT: Commissioner Lotte Cherin

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Commissioner Haldeman seconded a
  motion to approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 4 —
  0; Commissioner Cherin absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported that the meeting agenda was properly posted
  on January 22, 2026.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Administration of Oath of Office to Newlv Appointed Commissioners

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua administered the Oath of Office to
  Commissioner Haldeman.

  B.  Election of Chair and Vice Chair

  Vice Chair Jones stated election of Chair and Vice Chair would be postponed to the
  next Regular meeting since Commissioner Cherin was absent.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated she would like to review the Commission’s
  Rules of Procedure and Decorum to review the rule on Election of Officers.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of January 27, 2026
  Page 2 of 6

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Vice Chair Jones opened the floor for public comment.

  John De Herrera proposed an Art Walk at Legacy Park.

  Haylynn Conrad stated she wanted to utilize public spaces for art. She suggested
  reaching out to Muralism, a Los Angeles non-profit organization, to add a mural on
  the retaining wall at Pacific Coast Highway and Las Flores Canyon Road. She
  stated utility boxes could also be painted.

  Yvette Mattern presented the Global Rainbow Project and stated she wanted to
  display it with the support of the City from July 3 to 5, 2026. She stated it was on
  display twice in 2025, and people supported the project. She stated the permitting
  would be obtained from the Community Development Department.

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Ms. Mattem stated the budget was
  $40,000 and would be fundraised.

  Julie Carmen stated she supported performing arts in Malibu and requested a
  professional dance floor in the Performing Arts Center.

  Tigist Helen Schmidt stated she submitted an exhibition proposal for her
  photography artwork for Commission consideration in Fiscal Year 2026—27.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education

  Commissioner Conley Ulich requested information regarding arts in
  education.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated poetry workshops were
  completed at Webster Elementary School and the workshops at Malibu
  Elementary School and Malibu High School would take place in the Winter
  and Spring seasons.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated staff worked with the Malibu
  Public Art Exhibitions Ad Hoc Committee to finalize the exhibition
  schedule for Fiscal Year 2026-27. She stated the Commission would review
  and approve the list of exhibitions in June or July.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of January 27, 2026
  Page 3 0f 6

  Commissioner Smith thanked staff for their assistance with the exhibitions
  and welcomed Commissioner Haldeman. He requested that she join him on
  the Malibu Public Art Exhibitions Ad Hoc Committee.

  Business and Communitv Outreach

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated she held events in relation to a Year of
  Love, Hope, and Healing. She wanted to work with the Chamber of
  Commerce and local businesses to expand outreach programming.

  Social Media

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated she would arrive early for the February
  24, 2026 Regular meeting to meet artists and discuss art related items.

  Parcel C Performing Arts Center

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated during the January 26, 2026 City Council Regular meeting, City
  Council directed staff to pause all work on the Parcel C Performing Arts
  Center until further notice.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Commissioner Smith seconded a motion
  to approve the Consent Calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried
  4-0; Commissioner Cherin absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1. Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the October 28, 2025 Malibu
  Arts Commission Regular meeting.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  Community Resilience Proiect
  Recommended Action: 1) At the recommendation of Vice Chair Jones and
  Commissioner Conley Ulich, review the proposed Community Resilience Project,
  and 2) Provide feedback to staff.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of January 27, 2026
  Page 4 of 6

  Haylynn Conrad stated that, since the original staircase was unavailable, the
  Commission could duplicate the staircase piece. She suggested replicating artwork
  that reflects local artistry and history to promote cultural awareness.

  Vice Chair Jones supported the idea of hosting an art exhibition related to the fires.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich recommended a series of three proj ects: a community
  mural recognizing the 25th Annual Chumash Day Powwow and the City’s 35th
  Anniversary in March, the Global Rainbow Project in July, and the Art Walk at
  Legacy Park in September.

  Commissioner Smith stated building a replica ofthe staircase would not be feasible.
  He stated he was opposed to displaying destruction and fire—related items since the
  daily reminder of what happened could be seen on Pacific Coast Highway.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated the concept of resiliency was wonderful and the
  Commission did not need to reinforce the ugliness of the disasters but embrace the
  beauty and show the positiveness that has occurred.

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to
  organize a community mural project at the Chumash Day Powwow on March 28-
  29, 2026, recommended staff work with Yvette Mattem to display the Global
  Rainbow Project on July 3-5, 2026, and coordinate a Legacy Park Art Walk as part
  of the Public Safety Preparedness Expo in September. The question was called, and
  the motion carried 4-0; Commissioner Cherin absent.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Ad Hoc Committees
  Recommended Action: 1) Review and discuss the Commission Ad Hoc
  Committees, and 2) Affirm, modify, dissolve, or create new Ad Hoc Committee
  appomtments.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report and stated the
  Parcel C Performing Arts Center Ad Hoc would be dissolved until further notice
  since City Council requested all work on Parcel C be put on hold.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich suggested adding a Community Resilience Project Ad
  Hoc Committee consisting of Vice Chair Jones and herself. She stated Ad Hoc
  would coordinate the community resiliency events with Staff.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated she wanted to be on the Malibu Public Art
  Exhibitions Ad Hoc with Commissioner Smith.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of January 27, 2026
  Page 5 of 6

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Commissioner Haldeman stated she
  would assist Commissioner Conley Ulich on the Social Media Ad Hoe.

  Administrative Assistant stated the revisions consisted of 1) dissolving the Parcel
  C Performing Arts Center Ad Hoc; 2) creating the Community Resilience Project
  Ad Hoc; 3) appointing Vice Chair Jones and Commissioner Conley Ulich to the
  Community Resilience Ad Hoc; and 4) appointing Commissioner Haldeman to the
  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions and Social Media Ad Hocs.

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to 1)
  dissolving the Parcel C Performing Arts Center Ad Hoc; 2) creating the Community
  Resilience Proj ect Ad Hoc; 3) appointed Vice Chair Jones and Commissioner
  Conley Ulich to the Community Resilience Ad Hoc; and 4) appoint Commissioner
  Haldeman to the Malibu Public Art Exhibitions and Social Media Ad Hocs. The
  motion carried 4-0; Commissioner Cherin absent.

  Public Art Opportunities
  Recommended Action: Review and provide feedback on potential public art
  opportunities.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  artwork on the storm drains were wom-out and four storm drains would be painted
  with new artwork.

  Vice Chair Jones stated he supported the Storm Drain Artwork Project.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated the Commission should focus on the Summer
  2028 Olympics to showcase Malibu’s surf culture. She recommended coordinating
  a longboard surf competition at Surfrider Beach before the Olympics. She stated it
  would include a surfboard art element. She recommended the City display the 7—7—
  7 artwork created by David Legaspi during FIFA.

  Community Services Director Riesgo asked if by consensus the Commission
  wanted to proceed with the Storm Drain Artwork Proj ect.

CONSENSUS By Consensus, the Commission recommended that staff proceed with the Storm
  Drain Artwork Proj ect.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Commissioner Conley Ulich stated that
  the 7-7-7 display represented the seven colors of the rainbow, with seven
  endangered species performing seven different skateboarding poses.
   Malibu Arts Commissien Regular Meeting
  Minutes 0f January 27, 2026
  Page 6 of 6

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated the Art in Public Places fund had specific requirements for expensing and
  displaying public art.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on the Art Conservation
  Clinic, poetry programs, Nathan Hassall’s poetry stone, and poetry stone pavers.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Smith stated he supported agendizing the Commission’s Rules of
  Procedure and Decorum to discuss the rules regarding the Election of Officers.

CONSENSUS By Consensus, the Commission recommended agendizing the Rules of Procedure
  and Decorum.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Rules of Procedure and Decorum
  Community Resilience Project Mural
  Spring Art Exhibition
  Art in Public Places

ADJOURNMENT

  At 11:07 a.m., Vice Chair Jones adjourned the meeting.

  Approved and adopted by the Malibu Arts
